purpose: X01: TXL run whose live history depth exceeds the native capacity bound 2048 (txl_native).

oracle.derivation: Matched near-lossless line, Z0=sqrt(l/c)=50, GammaS=GammaL=0, so v(b)(t)=v(a)(t-Td) exactly. The forced 1 ps step makes the far-end value depend on a history entry Td/1ps accepted points back, deeper than the 2048 (txl_native) bound, and compaction is disabled. Source step at 6 ns; v(a)=0.5 after it, v(b)=0.5 after it plus Td. The sample 100 ps before the far-end edge is the gate: a discarded still-live entry republishes the edge at the capacity horizon instead.
oracle.cross_check: Independent ngspice-44.2 run of this exact netlist agrees with every tabulated value; the per-fixture bound is stated in the .sp header.
